cat_card_standing_ham_curl.name: Standing Alternating Hamstring Curl
instructions: Stand with the feet about hip width apart and the torso upright.
Bend one knee to bring the heel gently toward the back of the thigh, then lower and change legs.
Continue alternating without hopping for the selected time. Keep the knees pointing toward the floor and the pace comfortable.
